quasi_poisson_v2_retirement_disposal.disposal: The V2 retirement bounded CHALLENGER ACCURACY FAMILIES - routes to replacing the incumbent point estimator - and does not bind the shared scoring machinery of this preregistration. The quasi-Poisson IRLS freeze is a symmetric testing scaffold applied identically to every arm and its K0_MATCHED null: constant under-dispersion cancels exactly from the quasi-score equations (IRLS working weights proportional to 1/mu either way), point estimates are invariant to the dispersion constant, and NO likelihood-based standard error is ever consumed - all inference is game-cluster bootstrap. The 0.193 citation is scoped to exactly that constant-dispersion cancellation in the quasi-score, nothing more; the cited note is itself flagged 'NOT verified by the coordinator'. The dispersion-heterogeneity caveat is recorded: the regulation-equivalent rescale makes per-row quasi-dispersion heterogeneous (factors {1, 8/9, 4/5, 2/3} on the 4.4% OT rows), identical in arm and null, bootstrap-immune; 'dispersion irrelevant' means the constant-phi factor cancels, not that the variance model is right.
